description: This file defines the UserTaskEventContentDriver class, which manages user task event content within OrchardCore workflows, including editing, updating, and retrieving user task actions.

classes.name: UserTaskEventContentDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing user task event content within OrchardCore workflows, handling editing, updating, and action retrieval.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Prepares the editor interface for the content item, initializing user task actions.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles updates to the content item, triggering workflow events based on user actions.

methods.name: GetUserTaskActionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves available user task actions for a specific content item based on current workflows and user roles.

methods.name: GetUserTaskActions
methods.description: Generates a list of actions for a workflow state and activity, filtered by user roles.
